collection-source.why: TasksView subscribes to the shared `collection` via `collection.on('add remove reset sort')` and TaskRow to `change:priority` on the model, with no copied array; it ignores `sync`/generic `change`, which the original didn't use either.

paging.why: The effect calls `collection.fetch({remove:false, data:{page:++page}})` on the same collection, with a 250ms throttle and a 200px threshold, and removes the scroll listener and cancels the throttle on cleanup.

filter-sort.why: Archived rows are filtered and sorted by descending priority, but the list is deliberately not re-sorted when a model's priority changes (only on collection add/remove/reset/sort), and the criterion requires re-sorting on priority change.

empty.why:
When the filtered `models` list is empty it renders `
  • No open tasks
    • `, so the empty state accounts for the archived filter.

tooltip.why: The `useTooltip` layout effect initialises `$.fn.tooltip({placement:'top'})` on `[title]` targets per row on each render and calls `tooltip('dispose')` in cleanup.

no-silent-changes.why: React escapes title and owner by default, and the summary's 'Behavior differences' section flags the scroll attach timing, trailing-throttle cancel, tooltip dispose, and View-vs-CollectionView API change.
